questions.question: Docker Swarm nima? Manager va worker node farqi?
questions.explanation: Docker'ga o'rnatilgan orchestrator: bir necha host'ni klasterga birlashtiradi. Manager — klaster holati (Raft) va scheduling; worker — task'larni (container) ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: Swarm'da service, task va stack nima?
questions.explanation: Service — kerakli holat (image, replicas, port); task — bitta container'ning scheduling birligi; stack — compose fayldan bir nechta service'lar to'plami.

questions.question: Replicated va global service farqi?
questions.explanation: Replicated — N ta nusxa, scheduler node'larga taqsimlaydi; global — har node'da bittadan (monitoring agent, log collector).

questions.question: Swarm routing mesh va ingress network qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Publish qilingan port klasterdagi har node'da ochiladi; istalgan node'ga kelgan so'rov IPVS orqali service'ning istalgan task'iga yo'naltiriladi (ingress overlay). mode=host — faqat task turgan node'da, mesh'siz.

questions.question: Swarm'da rolling update va rollback qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: update_config: parallelism, delay, order (start-first/stop-first), failure_action (rollback/pause), monitor; rollback_config. docker service update --image ... / docker service rollback.

questions.question: Swarm secrets va configs qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Secret Raft log'da shifrlangan saqlanadi, faqat unga ruxsat berilgan service task'lariga /run/secrets/<name> (tmpfs) sifatida beriladi. Config — shifrlanmagan konfiguratsiya fayllari. Ikkalasi immutable — o'zgartirish uchun yangi nom.

questions.question: Placement constraints va node label'lar nima uchun?
questions.explanation: Task'larni aniq node'larga bog'lash: node.role, node.hostname, node.labels.*. Masalan DB faqat SSD diskli node'da. Preferences — zonalarga tekis tarqatish.

questions.question: Swarm manager'lar soni nega toq bo'lishi kerak? Quorum yo'qolsa nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Raft ko'pchilik (N/2+1) talab qiladi. 3 manager 1 ta yo'qotishga, 5 — 2 taga chidaydi; juft son qo'shimcha chidamlilik bermaydi. Quorum yo'qolsa mavjud task'lar ishlayveradi, lekin boshqaruv (deploy, scale, qayta scheduling) to'xtaydi.

questions.question: Swarm va Kubernetes: qachon qaysi birini tanlaysan?
questions.explanation: Swarm — sodda, Docker CLI/compose bilan, kichik jamoa va kichik klaster uchun tez. K8s — katta ekotizim (operator, HPA, RBAC, CRD, service mesh), murakkabroq, standart. Swarm ekotizimi kichik, kelajagi cheklangan.

questions.question: Swarm'da stateful service (DB) ishlatish muammolari?
questions.explanation: Volume local — task boshqa node'ga ko'chsa ma'lumot u yerda yo'q. Yechim: constraint bilan node'ga bog'lash, shared/CSI storage, yoki DB'ni klasterdan tashqarida (managed) saqlash.

questions.question: Swarm service'ni yaratish, ko'rish, scale, log, o'chirish buyruqlari?
questions.explanation: docker service create/ls/ps/scale/logs/update/rm. docker stack deploy/ls/ps/rm — stack darajasida.

questions.question: Overlay network nima va Swarm'da service'lar qanday gaplashadi?
questions.explanation: Overlay — bir nechta host ustidagi virtual L2 tarmoq (VXLAN). Bir overlay'dagi service'lar nomi bo'yicha (DNS -> VIP) bir-birini topadi, qaysi node'da ekanidan qat'i nazar.

questions.question: Node maintenance: drain, pause, active farqi?
questions.explanation: active — task qabul qiladi; pause — yangi task olmaydi, borlari qoladi; drain — yangi olmaydi va mavjud task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chiriladi.

questions.question: Swarm'da healthcheck va restart_policy qanday birga ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Swarm healthcheck unhealthy bo'lgan task'ni o'ldirib yangisini yaratadi. restart_policy: condition (none/on-failure/any), delay, max_attempts, window.

questions.question: Swarm service'da task `Pending` yoki `Rejected` holatda turibdi. Qanday debug qilasan?
questions.explanation: docker service ps --no-trunc xato matnini ko'rsatadi: constraint qondirilmagan, resurs (reservation) yetmaydi, image pull xatosi, port band, secret/network yo'q.

questions.question: `docker stack deploy` bilan private registry'dan image pull bo'lmayapti. Nega?
questions.explanation: Worker node'larda registry login yo'q. --with-registry-auth manager'dagi credential'ni task'larga uzatadi.

questions.question: Swarm klasterini monitoring va log yig'ish qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Global service'lar: node-exporter, cAdvisor (metrika), fluent-bit/Promtail (log). Prometheus Swarm service discovery (dockerswarm_sd_configs) bilan task'larni topadi. Daemon metrikalari metrics-addr bilan.

questions.question: Swarm overlay trafigini shifrlash va Swarm xavfsizlik modeli?
questions.explanation: Control plane (manager-node) mTLS bilan avtomatik, sertifikatlar rotatsiya qilinadi. Data plane overlay default shifrlanmaydi — --opt encrypted (IPsec) bilan yoqiladi, CPU narxi bor. Autolock Raft kalitini himoya qiladi.

questions.question: Swarm klasterini backup va disaster recovery qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Manager'dagi /var/lib/docker/swarm (Raft, secret, config) ni Docker to'xtatib backup qilinadi. Tiklash: yangi node'ga ko'chirib --force-new-cluster. Ilova ma'lumotlari (volume) alohida backup.

questions.question: Swarm'da service update qilindi, lekin replika'lar `Rejected`/`Pending`, update `paused`. Qanday debug qilasan?
questions.explanation: docker service ps --no-trunc xato sababini ko'rsatadi (image pull, resource, constraint, port). update_config failure_action pause bo'lgani uchun to'xtadi. Tuzat yoki `docker service rollback`.

questions.question: Yangi node Swarm'ga join bo'ldi, lekin u yerdagi task'lar boshqa service'larga ulana olmayapti. Nima tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: Overlay uchun portlar ochiq bo'lishi kerak: 2377/tcp (manager), 7946/tcp+udp (gossip), 4789/udp (VXLAN), encrypted overlay'da ESP (proto 50). Cloud SG/firewall, MTU.

questions.question: 3 manager'dan 2 tasi o'chdi (quorum yo'q). Qanday tiklaysan?
questions.explanation: Qolgan manager'da `docker swarm init --force-new-cluster` — u yagona manager bo'lib, state saqlanadi. Keyin yangi manager'lar join, toq son (3/5). Oldin /var/lib/docker/swarm backup.

questions.question: Node o'chdi, Swarm Postgres task'ini boshqa node'ga ko'chirdi — DB bo'sh holda ko'tarildi. Nima bo'ldi?
questions.explanation: Local volume node'ga bog'langan: yangi node'da yangi bo'sh volume yaratildi. Stateful service'ni constraint bilan node'ga pin qil yoki shared/replicated storage; DB'ni Swarm'dan tashqarida (managed) yaxshiroq.

questions.question: Swarm worker join token Slack'da tarqalib ketdi. Nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Token'ni darhol rotate: `docker swarm join-token --rotate worker` (manager ham bo'lsa uni ham). Begona node qo'shilganmi — docker node ls, keraksizini rm. Eski token bilan join'lar endi rad etiladi.

questions.question: Swarm klasterini qanday yaratasiz va node qo'shasiz?
questions.explanation: `docker swarm init --advertise-addr <ip>` manager yaratadi va join token beradi; boshqa node'lar `docker swarm join --token <token> <manager>:2377` bilan qo'shiladi.

questions.question: `docker service ps` va `docker service ls` nimani ko'rsatadi?
questions.explanation: `service ls` — service'lar va REPLICAS (masalan 3/3). `service ps <svc>` — har task: qaysi node'da, holati (Running/Failed/Shutdown), xato matni va tarix.

questions.question: Swarm'da stack fayli (`docker stack deploy -c`) va oddiy Compose fayldan farqi nima?
questions.explanation: Format bir xil (Compose spec), lekin stack `build:` ni qo'llamaydi (image registry'da tayyor bo'lishi kerak), `deploy:` bo'limi (replicas, update_config, placement) ishlaydi, `depends_on` e'tiborsiz.

questions.question: Swarm'da `update_config` parametrlari: `parallelism`, `delay`, `order`, `failure_action`, `monitor` — har biri nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: parallelism — bir vaqtda nechta task yangilanadi; delay — partiyalar orasida kutish; order: start-first (avval yangi, keyin eski o'chadi) yoki stop-first; failure_action: pause/rollback/continue; monitor — task'ni muvaffaqiyatli deb hisoblashdan oldin kuzatish vaqti.

questions.question: Swarm'da `endpoint_mode: vip` va `dnsrr` farqi? Qachon dnsrr kerak?
questions.explanation: vip: service bitta virtual IP oladi, IPVS load balance qiladi. dnsrr: DNS barcha task IP'larini qaytaradi, client o'zi tanlaydi — tashqi LB, client-side balancing yoki VIP bilan mos kelmaydigan protokollar uchun.

questions.question: Swarm node'ida disk/memory to'ldi va task'lar boshqa node'larga ko'chdi. Resurs reservation va limit qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: `reservations` — scheduler uchun: node'da shuncha bo'sh resurs bo'lmasa task joylashmaydi. `limits` — runtime cgroup chegarasi. Reservation'siz scheduler node'larni haddan tashqari to'ldiradi.

questions.question: Swarm'da `mode: host` va `mode: ingress` port publish farqi?
questions.explanation: ingress: routing mesh — har node'ning portiga kelgan so'rov istalgan task'ga yo'naltiriladi, client IP yo'qoladi. host: port faqat task ishlayotgan node'da ochiladi, client IP saqlanadi, bir node'da bitta task.

questions.question: Swarm'da node label'lar va `placement.preferences` (spread) bilan AZ bo'ylab taqsimlash qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Node'larga `docker node update --label-add zone=a` beriladi; `placement.preferences: - spread: node.labels.zone` task'larni zone'lar bo'ylab teng tarqatadi; `constraints` esa qat'iy filtr.

questions.question: Swarm'da Raft log va manager node'lar: manager'da workload ishlatish kerakmi? Manager'larni qanday himoyalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Prod'da manager'larni drain qilib faqat boshqaruv uchun qoldirish tavsiya etiladi: workload resurs bosimi Raft heartbeat'ni kechiktirib leader election va quorum muammosiga olib keladi. Autolock, TLS, firewall bilan himoya.

questions.question: Swarm overlay network'da servislar orasida vaqti-vaqti bilan ulanish uzilishlari va timeout'lar. Nimalarni tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: MTU (VXLAN 50 bayt overhead, cloud'da MTU kichik), 4789/udp va 7946 portlari firewall'da, IPVS idle connection timeout (900s) uzoq ulanishlarni uzadi, conntrack to'lishi, subnet to'qnashuvi.

questions.question: Swarm'da secret rotation qanday qilinadi, agar secret o'zgarmas (immutable) bo'lsa?
questions.explanation: Secret o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi: yangi nom bilan yaratiladi (`db_pass_v2`), service `--secret-rm` / `--secret-add` bilan yangilanadi (rolling update), eski secret keyin o'chiriladi. Stack'da nomga versiya/hash qo'shiladi.

questions.question: Swarm klasterini upgrade qilish (Docker Engine versiyasi) qanday zero-downtime bajariladi?
questions.explanation: Node-by-node: avval worker'lar (drain → upgrade → active), keyin manager'lar bittadan (quorum saqlanishi uchun), leader oxirida. Versiyalar aralash ishlashi qisqa vaqtga ruxsat etiladi.

questions.question: Kichik kompaniyada (3 dasturchi, 10 servis) Swarm ishlatilyapti. Board K8s'ga o'tishni talab qilyapti. Qanday baholaysiz?
questions.explanation: Qarorni texnik moda emas, o'lchangan og'riq va narx bo'yicha qil: Swarm hozir qaysi talabni bajara olmayapti? K8s'ning operatsion narxi (odam vaqti), managed variant, ekotizim foydasi va Swarm'ning uzoq muddatli qo'llab-quvvatlanish xavfi.

questions.question: `docker service scale` va `docker service update --replicas` farqi? Replika sonini qanday o'zgartirasiz?
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi ham replika sonini o'zgartiradi. `scale` bir nechta service'ni bitta buyruqda o'zgartira oladi; `update --replicas` boshqa parametrlar bilan birga. Stack'da esa manba — stack fayl.

questions.question: Swarm'da service discovery: servis nomi va `tasks.<servis>` DNS nomi farqi?
questions.explanation: `api` nomi VIP'ga resolve bo'ladi (bitta IP, load balance). `tasks.api` esa har bir task'ning IP'larini qaytaradi — client o'zi tanlashi yoki barcha peer'larni topishi uchun.

questions.question: Swarm'da job mode (`replicated-job`, `global-job`) nima? Qachon ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Docker 20.10+ da bir martalik vazifa: task muvaffaqiyatli tugasa qayta ishga tushmaydi. Migratsiya, batch, har node'da bir marta tozalash skripti uchun.

questions.question: `docker service rollback` nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Service'ni oldingi spec'ga (oldingi image, env, config) qaytaradi. Swarm faqat bitta oldingi versiyani saqlaydi.

questions.question: Swarm'da Traefik'ni reverse proxy sifatida qanday ishlatasiz (label-based routing)?
questions.explanation: Traefik Swarm provider orqali service label'larini o'qiydi va routing qoidalarini avtomatik yaratadi. Label'lar `deploy.labels` da (service darajasi), Traefik manager'da docker.sock bilan yoki socket-proxy orqali ishlaydi.

questions.question: Swarm'da autoscaling bormi? CPU yuklamasiga qarab replikalarni qanday oshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Native autoscaling yo'q. Tashqi tsikl kerak: Prometheus metrikasi → skript/tool (masalan orbiter, swarm-autoscaler) → `docker service scale`. Node autoscaling ham alohida (cloud ASG).

questions.question: CI/CD'dan Swarm'ga deploy qanday qilinadi? Manager'ga SSH yoki docker context?
questions.explanation: CI image'ni build/push qiladi, keyin manager'ga ulanib `docker stack deploy --with-registry-auth` bajaradi. Ulanish: `DOCKER_HOST=ssh://deploy@manager` yoki docker context, TLS'li 2376. Docker API'ni ochiq tarmoqqa chiqarmaslik.

questions.question: Swarm'da log'lar: har service uchun log driver va markaziy yig'ish qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: `logging:` bo'limida service darajasida driver (json-file/local rotation bilan, fluentd, gelf, loki plugin). `docker service logs` faqat json-file/local/journald bilan ishlaydi. Markaziy yig'ish odatda global agent (Promtail/Fluent Bit) bilan.

questions.question: Swarm'da named volume va stateful service: task boshqa node'ga ko'chsa ma'lumot nima bo'ladi? Qanday hal qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Default `local` volume node'ga bog'liq — task boshqa node'da bo'sh volume bilan ko'tariladi. Yechim: constraint bilan node'ga bog'lash, tarmoq storage (NFS, cloud volume plugin / CSI — Docker 23+ da Swarm CSI), yoki state'ni Swarm'dan tashqarida saqlash.

questions.question: Swarm configs: `docker config` bilan nginx.conf'ni qanday berasiz va yangilaysiz?
questions.explanation: Config — immutable, Raft'da saqlanadigan fayl, task'ga fayl sifatida mount qilinadi (shifrlanmagan, secret'dan farqi). Yangilash = yangi nomli config + service update. Stack'da nomga versiya/hash qo'shiladi.

questions.question: Swarm'ning ichki arxitekturasi: orchestrator, allocator, scheduler, dispatcher qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Manager'da desired state Raft'da. Orchestrator spec'ni task'larga aylantiradi, allocator IP/network beradi, scheduler task'ni node'ga biriktiradi, dispatcher worker'larga task beradi va heartbeat oladi. Worker agent task'ni containerd orqali ishga tushiradi.

questions.question: Swarm mTLS: node sertifikatlari, root CA rotation va sertifikat muddati qanday boshqariladi?
questions.explanation: Swarm o'z CA'sini yaratadi; har node mTLS sertifikat oladi, default 90 kunda avtomatik yangilanadi. `docker swarm ca --rotate` root CA'ni almashtiradi (CA kaliti sizib chiqsa). Tashqi CA ham ulanadi.

questions.question: Swarm'da bir nechta jamoa bitta klasterda ishlaydi. Izolyatsiya (network, resurs, ruxsat) qanday ta'minlanadi?
questions.explanation: Swarm'da namespace/RBAC yo'q (faqat Mirantis MKE'da). Izolyatsiya: alohida overlay network'lar (encrypted), node label bilan node pool, reservation/limit. Lekin manager'ga kirgan har kim hamma narsani boshqaradi — haqiqiy multi-tenant uchun alohida klaster.

questions.question: Swarm'da zero-downtime deploy uchun nima kerak: `start-first` yetarlimi?
questions.explanation: Yetarli emas: healthcheck (task healthy bo'lgunga qadar trafik bermaslik), graceful shutdown (SIGTERM, `stop_grace_period`), routing mesh/IPVS'dan chiqish vaqti, connection draining, backward-compatible DB migratsiya kerak.

questions.question: Swarm manager'larida yuqori CPU/xotira va `docker service ls` sekin. Sabablari va yechimi?
questions.explanation: Raft holati juda katta: ko'p task tarixi, ko'p service/secret, tez-tez update. Yoki manager'da workload. Yechim: `task-history-limit` kamaytirish, workload'ni drain, manager'larga tez disk, keraksiz stack'larni tozalash.

questions.question: Swarm klasterini ko'p region (multi-region) bo'ylab yoyish kerakmi? Qanday DR strategiya tanlaysiz?
questions.explanation: Bitta Swarm klasterini regionlar bo'ylab yoyma: Raft latency'ga sezgir, region uzilishi quorum'ni buzadi. Har regionda alohida klaster + global trafik boshqaruvi (DNS/GSLB) + ma'lumot replikatsiyasi. DR = qayta deploy qilish imkoniyati (stack fayl git'da) + ma'lumot.

questions.question: Swarm'da secret'larni boshqarish: Swarm secret yetarlimi yoki Vault kerakmi?
questions.explanation: Swarm secret: Raft'da shifrlangan, tmpfs orqali beriladi, lekin rotation, audit, dinamik credential, access policy yo'q. Kichik tizimga yetarli; compliance, ko'p jamoa, qisqa muddatli credential kerak bo'lsa Vault (yoki cloud secret manager) + Swarm secret'ni faqat bootstrap uchun.

questions.question: Swarm yoki Nomad yoki managed K8s yoki ECS: 30 kishilik jamoa uchun platforma tanlash mezonlarini qanday tuzasiz?
questions.explanation: Mezonlar: jamoaning operatsion quvvati, workload turlari (stateless/stateful/batch/GPU), ekotizim ehtiyoji, cloud strategiyasi (lock-in), yollash bozori, narx (odam vaqti + infra), chiqish narxi. Qarorni og'irlikli matritsa va pilot bilan qil.

questions.question: Swarm'dan Kubernetes'ga migratsiyani qanday rejalashtirasiz (50 servis, zero-downtime talab)?
questions.explanation: Bosqichma-bosqich, strangler pattern: ikkala platforma parallel, umumiy edge (LB/proxy) orqali trafikni servis-servis ko'chirish. Avval observability va CI/CD, keyin stateless servislar, state oxirida yoki managed. Har qadamda rollback = trafikni qaytarish.

questions.question: Swarm kabi "oddiy" orchestrator va K8s kabi kengaytiriladigan platforma o'rtasidagi tanlov — bu aslida qaysi chuqurroq arxitektura qarori?
questions.explanation: Bu qaror: platforma 'mahsulot' (cheklangan, fikrlangan, kam variant) yoki 'framework' (kengaytiriladigan, API/CRD, o'z platformangizni qurasiz). Swarm — opinionated tool, K8s — platforma qurish uchun platforma. Tashkilot o'zining platforma jamoasiga investitsiya qiladimi — shu asosiy savol.

questions.question: Siz tizim arxitektorisiz: nega Swarm, K8s va boshqa orchestrator'lar "desired state + reconciliation loop" modelini tanlagan? Bu modelning chegaralari qayerda?
questions.explanation: Imperativ buyruqlar partial failure'da noaniq holat qoldiradi; deklarativ desired state + doimiy reconciliation esa har qanday nosozlikdan keyin tizimni o'zi tiklaydi (level-triggered). Chegaralari: eventual consistency, kuzatish qiyin, tartib va bir martalik amallar (migratsiya), state'li tizimlar uchun noto'liq.
